channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Tiny Desk Concerts Japan
channel.desc:
Renowned Japanese artist and international star Fujii Kaze makes his way to NHK's tiny desk in Shibuya, Tokyo! Embracing the spirit of the tiny desk, Fujii Kaze performs a set of original music and delivers an unparalleled original experience.

SET LIST
Matsuri
Garden
damn
Kirari
Michi Teyu Ku (Overflowing)
Shinunoga E-Wa

MUSICIANS
Fujii Kaze: lead vocals, keys
Yaffle: keys
DURAN: guitar
Katsuya Takumi: bass
Kudo Seiya: drums
Yo-Sea: vocals
nishina: vocals.
